prompt: A new hire asks for "the architecture diagram" of a 20-service system. What does lesson 8 suggest asking first?

choices.text: Which notation they learnt at university
What question they are trying to answer
choices.why: Right: the level of zoom is chosen by the reader's question.
A preference for a family does not say which view helps.

choices.text: How many services they have worked with
choices.why: Experience does not pick the view.

prompt: Match each 4+1 view to its concern.

pairs.right: what the system does for its users
what runs at the same time, and under load
how the code is split into modules and teams

prompt: Docs as code puts the documentation in the same ___ as the code it describes.
Which documents are records, to be superseded rather than updated? Choose all that apply.

choices.text: A postmortem of last month's outage
choices.why: Yes: true as of its date.
No: it claims to be true now.

choices.text: An ADR choosing Pix for payouts
choices.why: Yes: superseded by a new ADR if the decision changes.

choices.text: A service README with its owner

prompt: Why does a diagram written as text suit code review better than one saved by a drawing tool?

choices.text: It looks better on a slide
choices.why: Autolayout is tidy and rarely beautiful; Renata still draws slides by hand.

choices.text: The line that adds an arrow is the line in the diff
choices.why: Right: a binary or XML file shows only that something changed.
Several are free; the issue is reviewing changes.

prompt: An on-call engineer follows a runbook that names a host decommissioned a year ago. In lesson 8's grid, where was the runbook, and which way out fits?

choices.text: Accurate and doubted; nothing to change
choices.why: It was wrong, and she trusted it.

choices.text: Out of date and doubted; it was already harmless
choices.why: She followed it, so it was trusted.

choices.text: Out of date and trusted: fix it or mark it
choices.why: Right: the costly corner, left by fixing it or making it impossible to trust by mistake.

choices.text: Accurate and trusted; the host should be restored
choices.why: The system moved on; the page is what is wrong.
